title: Day Sailing Adventure in the Florida Marine Sanctuary
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Escape the ordinary and embark on an unforgettable journey aboard our 50 foot sailboat, “Chao Lay”. Choose our popular 3-hour Day Sail through the Florida Keys Marine Sanctuary in Marathon, Florida. Our sailboat rides feature the perfect blend of natural beauty, maritime history, and the thrill of the open sea. Don't forget your camera – this is a photo opportunity you won't want to miss! Book your spot now and get ready to create memories that will last a lifetime.
